title: Submit inquiry successfully from header contact button
description: Verifies the contact modal opens from the header/hero and a fully completed form can be submitted to show a success message.

steps.description: Click "도입 문의하기" in the header/hero area
Type "도입 관련 문의드립니다." into the "message" field
Verify text "내용 확인 완료" is visible

title: Submit inquiry successfully and verify alternate success message is acceptable
description: Verifies that after successful submission the UI may show an alternate acceptable success message indicating follow-up.

steps.description: Click "도입 문의하기" in the header/hero area
Type "파트너 연동 및 심사 대응 관련 상세 안내 요청" into the "message" field
Verify text "담당자 연락 예정" is visible

title: Email required validation: blank email shows error then success after correction
description: Verifies required-email validation triggers on submit and can be resolved by providing a valid email to complete submission.

steps.description: Click "도입 문의하기" in the header/hero area
Verify text "내용 확인 완료" is visible

title: Email format validation: invalid email shows error then success after correction
description: Verifies invalid email format is rejected and the form can be submitted after providing a correctly formatted email.

steps.description: Click "도입 문의하기" in the header/hero area
Type "이메일 형식 검증 테스트" into the "message" field
Verify text "내용 확인 완료" is visible

title: Close contact modal without submitting
description: Verifies the modal can be closed via its Close control and no success state is shown afterward.

steps.description: Click "도입 문의하기" in the header/hero area
Click the "Close" button on the modal
Verify element "Contact/Inquiry modal" is not visible
Verify text "내용 확인 완료" is not visible

title: Open modal, partially fill, then close and confirm it is dismissed
description: Verifies the modal dismisses correctly even after the user has started entering data.

steps.description: Click "도입 문의하기" in the header/hero area
Click the "Close" button on the modal
Verify element "Contact/Inquiry modal" is not visible

title: Reopen modal after closing and verify it opens again normally
description: Verifies the contact modal can be opened, closed, and opened again without getting stuck.

steps.description: Click "도입 문의하기" in the header/hero area
Click the "Close" button on the modal
Verify element "Contact/Inquiry modal" is not visible
Click "도입 문의하기" in the header/hero area

title: Fallback path when Partner Login button shows no visible response
description: Verifies that when the header Partner Login button produces no modal, the user can still open the contact modal via the fallback CTA.

title: Repeated clicks on Partner Login still do not open a modal (known broken behavior)
description: Validates the current broken behavior: clicking Partner Login multiple times does not display a login modal.

steps.description: Verify element "partner login modal" is not visible

title: Fallback still works after multiple failed Partner Login attempts
description: Ensures the contact inquiry modal can be opened even after multiple Partner Login clicks with no visible UI.

title: Partner Login button is visible on initial load of /audit
description: Confirms the header contains the Partner Login entry point for auditors to attempt authentication.

title: Partner Login click does not navigate away from /audit
description: Verifies that clicking Partner Login does not trigger a route change (no navigation links should be relied on).

steps.description: Verify element "partner login modal" is not visible

title: Audit page loads and header navigation links are visible
description: Verifies the /audit landing page renders and header navigation links are present to interact with.

steps.description: Verify element "the page header" is visible
Verify element "a header navigation link" is visible

title: Clicking a header navigation link does not navigate away (placeholder behavior)
description: Verifies a header navigation link click does not change route when the link is a placeholder.

steps.description: Click on a header navigation link (for example, the first link in the header navigation)
Verify element "the audit page main content area" is visible

title: Repeated clicks on header navigation links do not change UI state unexpectedly
description: Verifies placeholder links do not trigger visible navigation, page reload, or unexpected UI changes after multiple interactions.

steps.description: Click on a header navigation link (for example, the first link in the header navigation)
Click on the same header navigation link again
Verify element "the page header" is visible
Verify element "the audit page main content area" is visible

title: Clicking different header navigation links still keeps the user on /audit
description: Verifies each placeholder header link behaves consistently and does not navigate away from the audit page.

steps.description: Click on a header navigation link (choose one link)
Click on a different header navigation link (choose another link)
Verify element "the audit page main content area" is visible

title: Header navigation click does not show an inline placeholder message (current behavior)
description: Verifies that clicking a placeholder navigation link does not display a visible fallback/placeholder message (until implemented).

steps.description: Click on a header navigation link (for example, the first link in the header navigation)
Verify text "Coming soon" is not visible
Verify text "Not available" is not visible
